punchline: Dan Harris had a panic attack on Good Morning America while reading the headlines to about five million people.
thirty_sec: Dan Harris spent years covering wars, came home depressed and started using cocaine and ecstasy on weekends. In 2004, filling in on Good Morning America, he panicked live halfway through six headlines and handed back with 'Back to you.' A psychiatrist told him the drugs had raised his adrenaline, so he quit. He thought meditation was for hippies, until his wife's favourite psychiatrist, Mark Epstein, got him to try it. It helped.
